svg.title: Spanreed Door Ajar: lockup construction (documentation)
svg.text: Door spans the descender line to the ascender line (crown +1.2 % optical overshoot). Gap door → S = 0.75 R. Clear space = 1.5 R (= 1 x-height). File padding 0.25 R.
Door height = 0.45 × wordmark ink width, centred on the ink.
Floor → x-height = 1 R. Clear space = 1 R. File padding 0.25 R.
Tile T = 2.4 cap heights, centred on the cap band. Gap tile → S = 0.25 T.
Clear space = 1 x-height. Soft shadow drawn without a filter.
4 · The symbol in R (256 grid: R = 62)
H = 200 (3.23 R), floor at 224, crown at 24
latch jamb 22 (0.35 R), light gap / caret 14 (0.23 R)
caret cap r 7, apex 4 above the springline
knob Ø 16 (0.26 R), 12 clear of the gap, 0.42 H up
small cut: W 128, caret 32, jamb 16, knob Ø 19.2 (16-unit grid)
